description: Prove that the same person is reachable on multiple transports. Options: (1) same TOFU key — kithd uses the same TLS cert on all transports, peers pin it once. (2) DID — publish one DID listing all transport endpoints; peers resolve and see both. (3) Manual claim — user asserts 'my other address is X', peer trusts. This is the hardest piece — without it, Alice-on-Tailscale and Alice-on-DNS look like two different people.
title: Multi-transport: cross-transport identity bridging
